definitions.explanation: Sweet foods or snacks; includes candy, cookies, cakes, etc.

examples.japanese: お{菓子|かし}が{好|す}きです。
お{土産|みやげ}にお{菓子|かし}をもらった。
examples.english: I received sweets as a souvenir.

notes:
お{菓子|かし} is a general term for sweets, snacks, and confections.

CATEGORIES:
- {和菓子|わがし}: traditional Japanese sweets
- {洋菓子|ようがし}: Western-style sweets
- {駄菓子|だがし}: cheap candy (nostalgic treats)
- {生菓子|なまがし}: fresh confections

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{菓子|かし}を{作|つく}る: to make sweets
- お{菓子|かし}{屋|や}: confectionery shop
- {手作|てづく}りのお{菓子|かし}: homemade sweets
- お{菓子|かし}{作|づく}り: making sweets

USAGE NOTE:
The お prefix (honorific) is commonly used but can be dropped: {菓子|かし}. In compounds, お is usually omitted: {和菓子|わがし}, {菓子|かし}{折|おり} (box of sweets).
